stem: Based on her letter, how has the author’s Hispanic heritage influenced her message?

options.label: F
options.text: She wants to encourage people to write about what makes their culture unique.

options.label: G
options.text: She wants to communicate the idea that a person from any culture can become a writer.

options.label: H
options.text: She wants to celebrate the accomplishments of Hispanic authors.

options.label: J
options.text: She wants to emphasize the importance of storytelling in Hispanic culture.
